Sanjay: Heads up — after converting HF SentencePiece tokenizer for model 'aurora-spm-v2' to our BPE pipeline, evals show quality regression on the chat benchmark and some chat templates are injecting <s> mid-sentence. Repro steps and quick logs below.

Sanjay: conversion command used: `python scripts/spm_to_bpe.py --spm model/sentencepiece.model --out converted/tokenizer.json --vocab converted/vocab.json --merges converted/merges.txt`

Sanjay: quick dump around the failure index (token ids):
```
# tokens around index 1024
1022: 304
1023: 305
1024: 2   <-- unexpectedly maps to <s>
1025: 309
```

Irene: :face_with_monocle: did we carry over all special tokens in config.json? (`bos_token`, `eos_token`, `unk_token`, `pad_token`, `additional_special_tokens`). SPM sometimes uses `<s>`/`</s>` and our conversion can remap them.

Alex: ran a quick check — the original SPM training used normalization=NFKC, but our BPE conversion pipeline defaulted to NFC. That changes how U+00A0 (non-breaking space) and some punctuation are tokenized.

Taylor: I also noticed merges ordering differences — when merges get re-sorted we reindex ids. If the conversion sorts merges alphabetically, token ids will shift and break templates that assume stable ids.

Sanjay: I thought the converter preserved order (spm -> id), but I did run a post-process dedupe that may have resorted things. Will check.

tokenizer-ci-bot: CI note — tokenizer-unit-tests failed 3/4 on `chat_templates.json` canonicalization check. Failing example snippets attached to CI job #224.

Irene: Quick checklist to try before deeper dive:
- preserve the original SPM id ordering when creating `vocab.json` (do not sort by token text)
- ensure `add_prefix_space` parity (SentencePiece implicitly models leading spaces; BPE's pre-tokenizer needs `add_prefix_space=True`)
- align `normalizer` settings (use NFKC if training used NFKC)
- copy `special_tokens_map` and explicit ids into `config.json` instead of relying on inference-time autodiscovery

Alex: FYI — in our quantization experiments, small tokenizer id mismatches get amplified: fp16 vs 8-bit runs diverge earlier when token ids differ for whitespace tokens. Repro pipeline I recommend: convert tokenizer -> validate tokenization on 10k canonical prompts -> run fp16 baseline and q4f16/q8 runs and diff outputs.

Taylor: snippet I used to inspect tokenization differences:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('converted/tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello\u00A0world').ids)
print(t.encode('Hello world').ids)
```

Sanjay: Plan: I'll redo conversion preserving SPM id mapping, force normalizer=NFKC, set `add_prefix_space=True`, and inject explicit special token ids into `config.json`. Then I'll re-run the eval subset and the quantized inference suite and post diffs.

Irene: If that doesn't fix it, fallback option: keep the original `.model` SentencePiece file and wrap it with a HF `SentencePieceTokenizer` (no conversion) to avoid id remapping in the short term.

Alex: please drop the failing input/gold/generated example in this thread when you have it so we can triage quickly. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: will do — re-running now, ETA ~45m, will attach logs & failing samples. Thanks everyone.
